itens.trecho: When "Moana" learns that the whole of Pacific Island society is under a curse from the powerful god "Nalo", she has to recruit a few faithful crew members and go seek out "Maui" before she can find the long lost and sunken island of "Morefutu".

A lot of people seem to hate this sequel for the sole reason it was retooled from a Disney+ series, but in my opinion, it made more sense to make it a movie versus a streaming service series, and I actually consider it to be an improvement over the first Moana.

Didn’t fill the shoes it created with the first one. Denouement was great but not good enough to redeem the whole film. Seemed like a 6th grade boy wrote the jokes. Chee hoo was annoying and I wish my tattoos came in like hers.
